# cvp_workspace_cancel_build (Action)

Cancel the in-flight build of the workspace (REQUEST_CANCEL_BUILD).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Invoke the cancel_build verb on a workspace.
action "cvp_workspace_cancel_build" "example" {
  config {
    workspace_id = cvp_workspace.example.workspace_id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The `workspace_id` of the target workspace.
